guide.deepspacedeployer.start_2: 1) Six companies run factories in the world (Terminal = shop, Acquisition = sell items, Core = build structures)
guide.deepspacedeployer.start_3: 2) Feed materials into an Delivery Buyer for company balance; low tier pays 0.8x, high tier 1.2x
guide.deepspacedeployer.start_4: 3) Right-click a Bank Card to bind an account; insert it into a Terminal to power it on (tier + reputation gated)
guide.deepspacedeployer.start_5: Details: /dsd guide card | buy | factory | weld
guide.deepspacedeployer.card_2: Right-click the card: enter a player name to bind, a card name to rename, or unbind
guide.deepspacedeployer.card_3: Money is stored per player inside blocks; spending uses the block balance first, then the card balance
guide.deepspacedeployer.buy_2: Drop items in, or pipe them with hoppers / Create arms; they convert to balance on the card holder account
guide.deepspacedeployer.buy_3: Selling to a high tier factory pays 1.2x; the buy list lives in data/deepspacedeployer/shop/*.json
guide.deepspacedeployer.factory_2: Put Create blueprints (.nbt) into config/deepspacedeployer/blueprints/ (admins: /dsd reloadblueprints)
guide.deepspacedeployer.factory_3: Pick a blueprint, feed materials (have/need shown), press Assemble and wait for the countdown
guide.deepspacedeployer.factory_4: Use Pick Target to choose the drop point on a top-down map; fee = 20 balance per block + materials
guide.deepspacedeployer.weld_1: ===== The welding bench has been removed =====
guide.deepspacedeployer.weld_2: The factory core now spawns physics structures directly; see /dsd guide factory

guide.deepspacedeployer.sub_1: [Sub card] Its balance is independent from the main card - a separate pool of money.
guide.deepspacedeployer.sub_2: To fund it: open the funds screen, put the main card in slot 1 and the sub card in slot 2, click Card 1 -> Card 2. (Right-click slot 2 to auto-fetch your sub card.)
guide.deepspacedeployer.sub_3: Acquisition income and purchases always use your MAIN account, so a sub card still buys things and still earns.
guide.deepspacedeployer.sub_4: Sub card money cannot be cashed out - transfer it back to the main card. Card-to-card transfers are free; cross-company costs 20%.
